audience.text: Java developers building server-side or desktop applications that require PDF document generation, manipulation, and extraction without third-party runtime dependencies.

capabilities.text: Build pages from scratch using Document, Page, Paragraphs, and objects like TextFragment, Table, Cell, and WidgetAnnotation.
capabilities.title: Create and edit PDF content

capabilities.text: Use TextAbsorber to extract plain text and iterate Resources.getImages() to extract XImage objects from pages.
capabilities.title: Extract text and images

capabilities.text: Access and modify form fields such as TextBoxField and RadioButtonOptionField through the Form API.
capabilities.title: Work with AcroForm fields

capabilities.text: Set and read border color, background color, and border style for annotations like WidgetAnnotation and RadioButtonOptionField.
capabilities.title: Configure widget annotation appearance

capabilities.text: Reduce file size with optimizeResources() and apply encryption or digital signatures using AES/RC4 and PKCS#7.
capabilities.title: Optimize and secure documents

capabilities.text: Validate and convert documents to PDF/A-1 through PDF/A-4 using PdfAValidator and PdfAConverter.
capabilities.title: Convert and validate PDF/A

capabilities.text: Export PDF pages to raster formats such as BMP, GIF, JPEG, PNG, and multi-page TIFF using device classes.
capabilities.title: Render pages to images

capabilities.text: Build and inspect tagged PDF structure trees and outline bookmarks using TaggedContent and OutlineItemCollection.
capabilities.title: Manage document structure

limitations.text: OCR functionality is not included; dedicated OCR libraries must be used for text recognition in scanned images.
Conversion to non-PDF formats other than HTML/XML is not supported; DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, EPUB, and similar are out of scope.
Full XFA form rendering is not reproduced; XFA data can be flattened to AcroForm but dynamic layout is not rendered.
PdfFileSecurity.setAllowExceptions throws UnsupportedOperationException; the legacy AllowExceptions=false path is not implemented.
Text replacement with non-Latin scripts may differ from a reference renderer due to limited bidirectional reordering and shaping.
Resource optimization supports basic stream recompression but advanced strategies like image downsampling and font merging are limited.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic creation and editing of PDF documents including text, tables, forms, annotations, and images using a consistent object model.
Supports extraction of plain text and images from existing PDFs via absorber and resource APIs.
Provides form field population and interaction with AcroForm widgets such as text boxes and radio button options.
Offers document optimization, PDF/A validation/conversion, encryption, and digital signing capabilities.

product_summary.text: Aspose.PDF FOSS for Java is a free, open-source, pure-Java library for creating, reading, and modifying PDF documents compliant with ISO 32000-1:2008.

uncertainties: The exact set of public symbols beyond org, org.aspose, and org.aspose.pdf is not fully enumerated in facts.
Support for public-key-encrypted PDFs via ICustomSecurityHandler is mentioned but no concrete usage example is provided in facts.
Coverage for building fully well-formed tagged PDF structure trees is described as partial but specific gaps are not detailed in facts.

workflows.name: Create PDF from scratch
workflows.text: Instantiate a Document, add a Page, insert TextFragment or WidgetAnnotation objects, and save to disk.

workflows.name: Extract text from PDF
workflows.text: Load a Document, create a TextAbsorber, accept it on pages, and retrieve extracted text as a String.

workflows.name: Extract images from PDF
workflows.text: Iterate over XImage objects in a page's Resources collection and save each to a file stream.

workflows.name: Populate form fields
workflows.text: Load a Document, access Form via getForm(), retrieve fields by name, set values, and save the filled form.

workflows.name: Build interactive form widgets
workflows.text: Create WidgetAnnotation or RadioButtonOptionField instances with a Rectangle, add them to a Page or Cell, and configure characteristics such as border color or style.
